title: Black Bodysuit Studio
reference_source: Максимальный гламурный регистр в рамках одетого кадра
mood_ru: Чистая студия, чёрный фон, один софтбокс. Только фигура и свет.
allure: editorial bodysuit glamour, high-cut bodysuit with a plunging neckline, long legs in sheer stockings, sculpted shoulders and waist, cool commanding gaze

wardrobe.notes_ru: Чёрное боди с глубоким вырезом, высокая посадка, плотная ткань. Чулки.
wardrobe.prompt: high-cut black bodysuit with a plunging neckline, opaque matte fabric, sheer black stockings, silver star pendant, bare feet, hair in a sleek low bun with loose strands

location.notes_ru: Тёмная студия, бесшовный чёрный фон, один софтбокс, легкая дымка.
location.prompt: dark photo studio, seamless black backdrop, single large softbox, faint atmospheric haze, black apple box, bare concrete floor, deep falloff into black

shots.pose: standing in profile turned into the light, back deeply arched, both arms raised overhead with wrists crossed, ribcage lifted, chin up, eyes closed
shots.camera: 85mm lens, eye level, side profile, full body framing
shots.light: one hard softbox edge sculpting the entire silhouette, everything else falling to black

shots.pose: tight portrait, chin lowered and eyes lifted straight into the lens, one hand resting at her throat, lips parted, sleek hair with loose strands
shots.camera: 85mm portrait lens, eye level, head-and-shoulders framing
shots.light: hard rim light along the jaw and cheekbone, single soft fill from the front, black background

shots.pose: kneeling back on her heels on the low black apple box, spine deeply arched, one hand planted beside her, head turned over the shoulder holding direct eye contact with the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, slightly above eye level, back three-quarter angle, full body vertical framing
shots.light: one large softbox raking from camera left, sculpting every line, a narrow hard rim light along her opposite side

shots.pose: standing close to the tall studio mirror at the edge of the set, one hand resting on the surface, hip pushed out, chin lowered, holding her own gaze while the camera catches her and the reflection at once
shots.camera: 50mm lens, eye level, over-the-shoulder into the reflection, thigh-up framing
shots.light: one large softbox raking from camera left, sculpting every line, a narrow hard rim light along her opposite side

shots.pose: standing at the edge of the black backdrop where the light falls off with one forearm raised against the frame, weight settled on one hip, back to the camera, long line of the spine on show, looking away into the light
shots.camera: 35mm lens, eye level, back view, full body vertical framing
shots.light: one large softbox raking from camera left, sculpting every line, a narrow hard rim light along her opposite side

shots.pose: reclining back on the low black apple box propped on both elbows, one knee raised and the other leg stretched long, ribcage lifted, chin up, half-lidded gaze straight down the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, low camera at surface level, three-quarter front angle, full body framing
shots.light: one large softbox raking from camera left, sculpting every line, a narrow hard rim light along her opposite side

shots.pose: cropped detail composition of the line of her waist and the edge of the bodysuit against the black, face out of frame, fingers relaxed and naturally posed
shots.camera: 85mm lens, close detail framing, very shallow depth of field
shots.light: one large softbox raking from camera left, sculpting every line, a narrow hard rim light along her opposite side

shots.pose: lying on her back on the low black apple box, one arm thrown above her head, the other hand resting on her waist, hair fanned out, knees softly bent, eyes lifted to the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, directly overhead top-down angle, full body framing
shots.light: one large softbox raking from camera left, sculpting every line, a narrow hard rim light along her opposite side

shots.pose: standing tall alone in the middle of the black set, one hand pushing back through her hair with the elbow raised, weight shifted onto one leg so the hip breaks the line, chin down and eyes up into the lens
shots.camera: 50mm lens, slightly low angle, frontal, full body framing
shots.light: one large softbox raking from camera left, sculpting every line, a narrow hard rim light along her opposite side

shots.pose: seen small across the space small against the huge black backdrop, caught mid-movement and not looking at the camera, the room itself carrying the mood
shots.camera: 24mm wide lens, eye level, wide environmental full-body shot
shots.light: one large softbox raking from camera left, sculpting every line, a narrow hard rim light along her opposite side
